query:
SELECT el.id AS "id!"
        FROM email_links el
        WHERE el.id = ANY($2::uuid[]) AND el.macro_id = $1
        UNION
        SELECT delegated.link_id
        FROM (
            SELECT mul.link_id, mul.primary_macro_id
            FROM macro_user_links mul
            WHERE mul.link_id = ANY($2::uuid[])
            OFFSET 0
        ) delegated
        WHERE delegated.primary_macro_id = $1
